section: Perspectives in Education · Ch — Teacher Empowerment
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: A trainee teacher practises teaching one specific skill (like questioning or explaining) to a small group of peers for a short duration (5-10 minutes), receives immediate feedback, then re-teaches the same lesson to improve that specific skill. This teacher-training technique, which breaks teaching down into discrete skills practised in a scaled-down setting, is called:
explanation: Micro-teaching is a teacher-training technique where a specific teaching skill is practised on a small scale (fewer students, shorter time, single skill), followed by feedback and re-teaching (the 'teach-feedback-reteach' cycle) — widely used in pre-service teacher education.
